findings.claim: The plan depends on library candidate decisions that are not present in the supplied artifact, leaving downstream implementers without definitions for referenced candidate IDs.
findings.evidence: plan.md says "analysis/candidates and architecture-proposal.md define one owner and explicit protocol versions," prior_handoffs says analyze output included "library-candidates.json," and implementation-roadmap.md references "libraries cand-001/cand-005," "cand-001/cand-002/cand-003," and "cand-004," but file_tree contains no library-candidates.json.
findings.suggested_fix: Include library-candidates.json in the published planning packet or replace cand-* references with explicit library names, decisions, and adoption constraints in the roadmap.

findings.claim: Task 1.1 over-orders unresolved storage backend capability decisions into the documentation freeze despite prior evidence assigning those guarantees to implementation gates.
findings.evidence: plan.md task 1.1 requires "settle versions, limits, storage capabilities, migration approach and local-release dependencies," but research/source-verification.md says confidence is "unresolved for installed behavior, database transaction guarantees under the selected backend and unmeasured performance targets. These remain implementation gates," and implementation-roadmap.md places the storage decision under I2: "Storage decision before implementation: identify selected existing backend's actual transactions/CAS/uniqueness behavior."
findings.suggested_fix: Change task 1.1 to freeze the required storage capability contract and explicitly defer selected-backend proof and capability certification to I2.
